title: Tests bypass the packaged CLI and export surfaces

evidence.quote: import { diffModels, parseDocx, type DocModel } from '../src/index.js';

reasoning: This feature is specifically about the CLI entrypoint and package-level public API, but the linked tests import the TypeScript source index directly and do not spawn the packaged bin or import through the package exports declared in package.json. A broken dist export map, bin target, shebang, or command parser regression could ship while these tests still pass.
recommendation: Add a package-surface smoke test after build that imports @docgit/core through the package entrypoint and runs the docgit bin against a temporary DOCGIT_DIR for at least help/version and one commit/log flow.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current linked tests validate implementation modules through ../src/index.js and direct store/parser calls; they never exercise package.json exports or the docgit binary.
suggestedRegressionTest: After pnpm --filter @docgit/core build, run a test that imports the built package root and executes dist/cli.js or the package bin with --help, --version, commit, and log against a temporary fixture.
minimumFixScope: Add one package-entry smoke test for @docgit/core exports and one CLI smoke path for the bin.
